context_sources.notes: Week 6 statuses for Daniels, Diggs, McLaurin, Evans, Kirk, Samuel and Bosa.

records.core_selection_rule: Over odds -350 to -150 inclusive; closest numerically to -250; tie favors more negative odds
records.stage3_candidate_rationale: At least one selected Floor/Core/Ceiling band has historical HR ≥14/20; retain for Stage 3 context.

factors.finding: QB1; Week 5 return produced 199 passing yards plus 103 rushing yards, sustaining overall offensive involvement.
Week 5 was his first game back after missing two games with an elbow dislocation; passing yards exceeded 175 but sample is one game.
Reported full participation and no game designation; recent elbow dislocation remains relevant context.
San Francisco defense is generally rated strongly and Washington's left-tackle situation raises pressure risk; Nick Bosa is out, partially offsetting this.
Washington could throw more if trailing, but pressure and offensive efficiency are countervailing risks.

stage3_context.final_selection_implication: 175+ has supportive L20 and he cleared it in Week 5, but this is only one post-elbow-injury game and Washington's protection is a concern.
